Team —

We have 6 weeks until the Q1 feature launch (public docs + paid tier). I want a tight preflight across enablement, pricing and support. High-level asks:

- Docs: need final code samples and a concise migration guide for existing customers. Target: publish v1 by Dec 20.

I've attached a draft checklist (launch_preflight_checklist.xlsx) and a suggested enablement schedule. Please reply with owners, blockers, and any missing items. I will collate and present at Friday's leadership sync.
